audit.whatIsWrong: full-layer phases[4].side reads 'Skill' (Level 6) while content win[4]='Karthus' and whys[4] already argues Karthus wins that level.
audit.why: whys[4] states Requiem/passive grow his threat at 6, which is a Karthus-favor verdict, not a skill-window — the full layer never caught up to content.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side -> Karthus, matching content win[4] and whys[4].

audit.why: Spikes correctly identify lvl3-5 poke window, lvl6 tilt via AP scaling, 1st item AoE threat, and late global burst outscale.

audit.whatIsWrong: The passive is named 'Death Defiance' in spikes[1].text and whys[4]; Karthus's real passive is Death Defied. breakdown.cooldowns also has no real cooldown number, and neither field states that Requiem is a 3s channel your Encore/Beat Drop cancels outright, or that Wall of Pain can cut your retreat.
audit.why: Riot's kit names the passive Death Defied (packet suspectNames flags this exact 4-edit-distance typo). The missingInteractions entries confirm Requiem is a channel any CC interrupts and Wall of Pain (15s CD, 1000 range) creates terrain that blocks your escape since you have no dash.
audit.corrected: Fix the ability name to Death Defied; state Requiem's 3s channel is cancelled by your E Beat Drop or R Encore, and that his W Wall of Pain (15s CD) can wall off your retreat — hold Flash for the wall, not just the ult.

edits.before: Encore online — the cross-map charm extends through your whole team; fights start two screens early.
edits.after: Requiem online — his AP scaling and Death Defied passive grow his threat past what your Encore alone offsets.

edits.before: Level 6 tilts to him: Requiem and Death Defiance grow his threat.
edits.after: Level 6 tilts to him: Requiem and Death Defied grow his threat.

edits.before: His R Requiem is global execute pressure but doesn't win lane trades; the danger is his E Defile ramping AoE and passive Death Defiance, so respect his zone -- his level 6 shifts the matchup toward him as his AP scaling comes online.
edits.after: His R Requiem is global execute pressure but doesn't win lane trades; the danger is his E Defile ramping AoE and passive Death Defied, so respect his zone -- his level 6 shifts the matchup toward him as his AP scaling comes online.

edits.before: - Karthus Requiem: matchup-defining — The global execute — recall above the red line and track it from his level 6 on. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Beat Drop for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Karthus Requiem (200/180/160s CD, 3s channel): recall above the red line, and any CC — your E Beat Drop or R Encore — cancels it outright if you catch the cast. - His W Wall of Pain (15s CD) walls off your escape since you have no dash — hold Flash for the wall, not the damage.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: Punish his immobile body while Q Lay Waste (no cooldown but a wind-up) is on the ground — he has zero mobility to answer a step-up.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.
edits.after: Walking through a fresh Wall of Pain (W) to retreat — it slows and shreds MR, turning a clean disengage into a kill.
